extracted.name: Summer Brew
extracted.description: Summer brew is a crowd-pleasing refreshing cocktail drink that’s easy to make with vodka, beer, and frozen limeade for those hot summer days.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed
3 (12 fluid ounce) bottles Mexican beer (such as Corona®)
instruction_lines: Combine the limeade, beer, and vodka in a pitcher; gently stir. Serve over ice and garnish with lime wedges.
